_doc:
The I-539 sidebar as myUSCIS ACTUALLY served it on 2026-08-14, read off live draft 13192080 (an F-1 -> H-4 change of status, i.e. a WORKER-DEP dependent). Captured by reading every anchor under the draft base path, so this is the form's own route table for that case, not a transcription.

WHY A SECOND CAPTURE EXISTS. i539-online-field-dump/ was taken 2026-07-15 off an F-1 change-of-status draft and recorded three of these pages WITHOUT the '/...-page-1' child segment. USCIS has since split them, matching the '-page-2' pattern that already existed beside each one. Page detection is a path-SUFFIX match, so the descriptor's older bare slugs stopped matching anything and the walk skipped those pages in silence — which is SOF-1278: 'Your immigration information', the A-Number and every Moral Character answer left blank on a filled questionnaire.

The FIELD NAMES on those pages did not change; only the routes did. That is why this fixture records slugs alone and the field-level dump stays where it is.

THIS IS AN H-4 SIDEBAR, so it carries the H-dependent evidence pages and NOT the F/M ones (form-I-20, proof-of-ability-to-pay, written-statement) — the evidence section is target-dependent. The guard that reads this file therefore asserts LIVE is a SUBSET of what the descriptor declares, never the reverse.
case_shape: F-1 -> H-4 change of status (worker's dependent)
_h1_note: Every page's <h1> is the same string, 'I-539, Application To Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status' (confirmed live on four separate pages). So pageForHeading CANNOT rescue a slug that stops matching — the URL is the only signal this form gives us, which is why a stale slug fails silently instead of degrading.

_evidence_notes./evidence/proof-of-relationship-to-h-tem: Heading 'Evidence Of Your Relationship With The H Temporary Worker'. A single dropzone, accept=image/jpg,image/jpeg,application/pdf,image/tif,image/tiff.
_evidence_notes./evidence/additional-evidence-for-depend: Heading 'Additional Evidence For Dependents Of An H Temporary Worker'. Same dropzone and accept list.
